Tablature —

Fugue

356 movements

Bach's organ music arranged for a band, one voice per instrument. Each numeral is that player's own PDF — notation over tablature — and GP5 is every part together, for Guitar Pro. The last three shelves are Guitar Pro files for now; open one and it will print you whatever parts you want.
